answer: Sealed Challenge Lineage. Each agent must solve a fresh, server-issued computational puzzle whose solution seeds the next round's puzzle, chaining identities to prior work. Solutions are committed before the next challenge opens, so copying another agent's answer fails the seed check. An attacker must forge a valid lineage from genesis for every fake identity, paying full compute per chain. Old solutions, like shale strata, cannot be reused across epochs; idle chains decay in a tundra of expired seeds.
